ProgramUnit.Name: VALID_PRODFORMULA_OLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE valid_prodformula_old IS
 i NUMBER(3);
 temp_v_curr_str VALID_PRODUCTS.PRODUCT_FORMULA%TYPE;
 temp_c_char VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 temp_v_curr_str := NAME_IN(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM);
 IF instr(temp_v_curr_str,'@',1) = 0 THEN
 show_error('9723');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 i := 1; 
 temp_c_char := SUBSTR(temp_v_curr_str,i,1);
 i := i + 1;
 -- Check if the first character is @.
 -- If it is other then raise error 
 IF temp_c_char != '@' THEN
 show_error('9723');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 temp_c_char := SUBSTR(temp_v_curr_str,i,1);
 i := i + 1;

 --Check if the second character is a numeric
 --If it is not a numeric then raise and error 
 -- IF instr('0123456789',temp_c_char,1) = 0 THEN
 -- show_error('9723');
 -- check_package_failure;
 -- END IF;

 temp_c_char := SUBSTR(temp_v_curr_str,i,1);
 i := i+1;

 --Checking if the third character is numeric or not
 --If it is not numeric then raise an error
 -- IF instr('0123456789',temp_c_char,1) = 0 THEN
 -- show_error('9723');
 -- check_package_failure;
 -- END IF;


 LOOP 
 IF i >= NVL(LENGTH(temp_v_curr_str), 0) THEN
 exit;
 END IF;
 temp_c_char := SUBSTR(temp_v_curr_str,i,1);
 i := i + 1;
 -- Check if the first character is @.
 -- If it is other then raise error 
 IF instr('@',temp_c_char,1) != 0 THEN

 temp_c_char := SUBSTR(temp_v_curr_str,i,1);
 i := i + 1;
 IF instr('0123456789',temp_c_char,1) = 0 THEN
 --show_error('9723');
 --check_package_failure;
 null;
 END IF;
 temp_c_char := SUBSTR(temp_v_curr_str,i,1);
 i := i+1;
 IF instr('0123456789',temp_c_char,1) = 0 THEN
 --show_error('9723');
 --check_package_failure;
 null;
 END IF;

 ELSIF instr('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ',temp_c_char,1) != 0 THEN 
 temp_c_char := SUBSTR(temp_v_curr_str,i,1);
 i := i + 1;
 IF instr('0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ',temp_c_char,1) = 0 THEN -- SCR 1961 - added all the alphabets
 show_error('9723');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 temp_c_char := SUBSTR(temp_v_curr_str,i,1);
 i := i+1;
 IF instr('0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ ',temp_c_char,1) = 0 THEN -- SCR 1961 - added all the alphabets
 show_error('9723');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SPLIT_PRODFORMULA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SPLIT_PRODFORMULA (pl_old_formula in varchar2,
 pl_prod_formula in varchar2) IS
 i NUMBER(3);
 temp_v_curr_str VALID_PRODUCTS.OLD_PRODUCT_FORMULA%TYPE;
 cursor c1 is 
 select va.attrib_group, va.attrib_code, va.attrib_desc, mc.code_desc 
 from valid_attributes va, valid_product_cclass_attr_isbt pca, 
 master_codes mc
 where pca.product_code = :ctrl_block_1.product_code
 and pca.attrib_group = va.attrib_group
 and pca.attrib_code = va.attrib_code
 and pca.attrib_group = mc.code
 and mc.code_type = 'ATTR';
BEGIN
 temp_v_curr_str := pl_old_formula; ----NAME_IN(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM);
 i := 1;
 --set_item_property('DISPLAY_ATTRIB.ATTRIB_GROUP', NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE); -- IM 10071
 set_item_property('DISPLAY_ATTRIB.ATTRIB_GROUP', NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);-- IM 10071
 go_block('display_attrib'); 
 clear_block;
 For rec in C1
 LOOP
 :display_attrib.old_attrib_group := rec.attrib_group;
 :display_attrib.old_attrib_code := rec.attrib_code;
 --:display_attrib.attrib_desc := rec.attrib_desc;
 --:display_attrib.attrib_group_desc := rec.code_desc;
 next_record;
 END LOOP; 
 
 
 
 -- For populating the old group and code
 LOOP
 :display_attrib.old_attrib_group := SUBSTR(temp_v_curr_str,i,1);
 :display_attrib.old_attrib_code := SUBSTR(temp_v_curr_str,i,3); 
 i := i+3;
 
 /* BEGIN
 SELECT code_desc
 INTO :display_attrib.attrib_group_desc
 FROM master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'ATTR'
 AND code = :display_attrib.attrib_group
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 clear_block(no_validate); 
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.product_formula'); 
 show_error('1110');
 check_package_failure; 
 WHEN others THEN
 clear_block(no_validate); 
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.product_formula'); 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END; 
 BEGIN
 SELECT attrib_desc
 INTO :display_attrib.attrib_desc
 FROM valid_attributes
